The monitoring consists of two parts: 1.) High acceleration monitoring: The failure is set if the longitudinal acceleration is | higher than a minimum threshold %{ 0.5 | m/s’2 | 1 | AxsHighAccelerationMonitoringAddThreshold }% added by a | threshold depending on velocity %{ 3.5 | m/s4‘2 | 1 | AxsPlausibilityMonitoringThresholdTable }% for a long time during | driving. 2.) Plausibiltiy versus vehicle acceleration: The failure is set if the difference between measured longitudinal | acceleration and longitudinal acceleration calculated by differentiating vehicle velocity is higher than a velocity | depending threshold %{ 3.5 | m/s42 | 1 | AxsPlausibilityMonitoringThresholdTable }%.

The monitoring consists of two parts. 1.) Offset monitoring: The failure is set if the long time filtered longitudinal | acceleration value called longitudinal acceleration offset is higher than a specific threshold %{ 2.25 | m/s‘’2 | 2 | | P_axOfsLZAErr }%. Calculation of the longitudinal acceleration offset is done in this way: During normal driving for a | long time a symmetrical driving situation is supposed. In this case the mean driving direction is on a plane surface and | the long time filtered longitudinal acceleration should be zero. The deviation from the zero position is the longitudinal | acceleration offset. The offset is stored in the eeprom over the power cycle. 2.) s_dsc: Temporary system degradation due to multiple WSS fault suspicion.
l_dsc: The failure is set if ABS and EBD are released by diagnosis and system management while these controllers are not | able to work because required input signals are not available with sufficient quality. This is the case if WSS input signals | from less than two wheels are available without assigned fault or fault suspicion for min. 0,5 s consecutively (e.g. the | failure is set if at least three WSS show an implausible behavior for 0,5 s). If detection is occurring during an ABS or | EBD control on the rear axle, the failure setting is shifted until control on rear axle is finished. The implausibility can be | due to different reasons: a) fault assigned to any wheel (ModeFail, SupplyGnd, SupplyHigh, LineHigh, LineGnd, | LineUndef, TestFailure, DmaBufNoise, WrongSens, NoEdge, VdaParityBitFail, MonRange, SignalLost, MonvVDiff, | MonMissingTeeth, MonNoise), or b) implausible WSS signal detected temporarily due to 1.) wheel speed is higher | than a specific threshold %{ 82.23 | m/s | 2 | SspWss_SiS_vMax }% for min.0,5s. 2.) wheel speed stays at zero after | drive off afterwards the vehicle velocity increases a specific threshold %{ 3.3 | m/s|1]| }%. 3.) wheel speed drops to | zero while the vehicle is faster than a_ specific velocity threshold %{ 33 | m/s | 2 | | MAX(MAX((SspWss_vDOLO_CheckFailLower*((48/2)/(AnzahlZaehne_VA/Abrollumfang_VA))),SspWss_vDOLO_Check | FailLower),SspWss_v_DOHI_Offset)}% and the vehicle does not decelerate below the vehicle speed that was present | when the initial wheel speed drop occurred. 4.) wheel acceleration is implausible high, the wheel jerk is implausible | high or edges and time information do not match at low speed. 5.) wheel speed differs from other wheel speeds more | than a calculated threshold and a varying duration. The threshold is depending on vehicle speed and current system | mode, the debounce time is depending on drive situation, current system mode and project specific threshold.

If | during stable vehicle behaviour a lateral acceleration failure larger than approximately a sum of %{ 2.0 | m/sA? | 1 | | zDifAyErrC1}% and needed increase in tolerance based on the situation occurs, the failure condition is fulfilled and a | fault is recognized during straight ahead driving, when the failure counter tayFV1 reaches %{1600 | ms | 0 | tayFV1Sw * | 40 }% during model validity.During cornering only the failure counterincreases and when the threshold is reached the | vehicle dynamics controller will disregard the sensor information so that a false intervention is prevented.2) Monitoring | during model observability:By building a reference lateral acceleration from all available sensor signals - steering angle - | yaw rate - lateral acceleration - wheel speed sensors - it is possible to test the lateral acceleration signal on plausibility. | lf during stable vehicle behavior a lateral acceleration failure larger than approximately %{ 2.0 | m/sA? | 1 | | zDifAyErrC1}% and needed increase in tolerance based on the situation occurs, after a time of %{120 | ms | 0 | | tayFV2Sw1*40}% the vehicle dynamic controller will disregard the sensor information so that a false vehicle dynamic | intervention is prevented. During observability the recognition time depends on the amount of failure. The deviation of the | measured signal from the model values is integrated when exceeding the allowed threshold. The shut down threshold | for the fault integral IBeta is %{ 4.363 | 1/s | 2 | IBetaMax*(3.1416/180)/0.04 }% .During cornering only the fault integral | increases, fault is only set during straight ahead driving.

s_dsc: APB ASIC is in wrong SPI mode.
l_dsc: APB ASIC is by default at STM SPI mode after Power on reset. The target SPI mode is Bosch SPI mode. In init task, a | SPI mode change sequence is done before any SPI communication. And software checks whether the SPI mode is the | target after the SPI mode change sequence. If the SPI mode is not the target, this failure will be set.

s_dsc: ASIC Init test failed during init task

s_dsc: APB Asic internal voltage bits stuck
l_dsc: Control of the internal voltage monitoring of the APB ASIC. If overvoltage, undervoltage or groundloss is detected in the | APB Asic the failure counter get raised. Continuously activation in 5ms task. The monitoring threshold is 30ms.

l_dsc: The oscillator monitoring init test detect a malfunction or a stuck bit inside the APB Asic. Triggers a failure at oscillator 1 | and controls that the APB Asic performs as anticipated.

Software triggers an APB ASIC reset at init task. If a APB ASIC reset(Initial Start Up) test failed during the reset, or time | out reached, or SP! communication with APB ASIC failed, this failure word will be set.

l_dsc: The TestTimeoutMonitoring runs permanently. The monitoring detects a too often aborted test because of external | conditions (undervoltage, load dump, ...).

The FreewheelingPathTest is a cyclic test (every 20s outside motor actuation) to check, if Freewheeling (FW) FET and | the ReverseVoltageProtection (RVP) FET is switchable. Additionally an interrupted motor, interrupted pin connections | and interruptions in the complete comparator circuit and FWD path are detected.
The MrgTest is a cyclic test (every 20s outside motor actuation) to check, if the motor actuation logic within ASIC works | and if the motor relay is switchable.

s_dsc: ASIC internal problem in the Load Dump logic.

s_dsc: ASIC internal logic problem (missing failure detection).

The MrsNegMonitoring runs permanently while motor actuation. The MrsNegTest is a cyclic test (initially and every 20s | outside motor actuation, if vehicle speed is higher than 15kph).The monitoring / test detects freewheeling (FW) path | interruption and a motor interruption.

Above this vehicle speed the failure | threshold is a relative value %{ 6 | % | 2 | SspWss_MonvVdiff_vDiff_Lo6 }%.
